composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the lunch box centered and filling about 75% of the frame with even margins (at least 12% on every side). The open box is the GROUND on which a miniature town will be placed later, so the whole pale cream interior must stay EMPTY, smooth, evenly lit and uncluttered — clear flat space with no food, no dividers, no pattern, no clutter. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the lunch box floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only inside the box. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
food, rice, or anything placed inside the box
compartment dividers, inner trays or patterned lining
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the lunch box
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the lunch box.
purpose: 給食 WORLD の WORLD MAP の地面。開いた弁当箱の中に小さな町（畑・調理場・こんだて机）が置かれる土台なので、内側は完全に空で平ら
scene: one OPEN school lunch box (弁当箱) seen from the same 35-degree above-front camera as the tray: a rounded rectangular box with a warm coral-red lid hinged open and standing up behind it, and a pale warm cream interior that is completely EMPTY, smooth and flat, like a shallow empty clay dish waiting to hold a miniature town. Same matte clay / miniature toy material, same lighting and same warm palette as the cream lunch tray and the dish set. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
required_objects: one open lunch box with a coral-red lid hinged open behind it
a completely empty, smooth, evenly lit pale cream interior with clear flat space
